title: Blocks of the trace assignment
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $c$ be a binary code for its optional states, let $y$ be a finite binary word, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The block of snapshot variables at time $t$ in the assignment encoding the run of $M$ on $y$ is exactly the binary encoding of the machine's snapshot at time $t$ on input $y$.
hypotheses_covered: A binary code for the optional states of $M$
replaced: For every machine, state code, input word $y$, and time $t$, the raw block of the trace assignment at time $t$ equals the encoding of the genuine snapshot of the run on $y$ at time $t$; quotient and remainder recover each complete block.
